findings.summary: Loading state is a bare Arabic text paragraph instead of the shared LoadingScreen/skeleton primitive used across the app.
findings.fix:
Import and render LoadingScreen from '../../ui/LoadingScreen' (or a card skeleton) in place of `

جارٍ التحميل…

` so the loading experience matches other pages.

findings.summary: The modal close button is an icon-only '✕' button with no aria-label, so screen readers announce nothing meaningful.
findings.fix: Add aria-label="إغلاق" to the close `<button>` (and ideally the .icon-button class) so it is announced and styled consistently.

findings.summary: The modal is a bespoke overlay with no role="dialog"/aria-modal, so assistive tech does not treat it as a dialog.
findings.fix: Add role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby pointing at the heading on the overlay container for accessible dialog semantics.

findings.summary: Signature-role checkboxes render raw English keys (employee/manager/hr/executive) as visible RTL Arabic labels, inconsistent with the Arabic UI.
findings.fix: Map each key to its Arabic label (الموظف/المدير/HR/التنفيذي) as done in line 17 instead of rendering the raw `{k}` string.

findings.summary: Modal overlay uses hardcoded Tailwind color `bg-slate-950/60` instead of a design token, so it won't adapt to dark theme surfaces.
findings.fix: Replace `bg-slate-950/60` with a token-based scrim such as `bg-[color:var(--surface-strong)]/60` or a shared overlay class defined via design tokens.

findings.summary: The 'النوع' (documentType) field is a free-text input despite the draft defaulting to a constrained value ('letter').
findings.fix: Render documentType as a `<select className="input">` of the known document types (letter/contract/certificate) with a proper label, matching the app's select-based enum pattern.

findings.summary: Document status/pending column uses `text-left` for alignment which fights the RTL layout instead of logical end alignment.
findings.fix: Use `text-end` (logical property) instead of `text-left` so alignment is correct under RTL.

findings.summary: Multiple statements and hooks are collapsed onto a single line hurting readability and consistency with the rest of the codebase.
findings.fix: Split the `useState`, hook calls, and draft initialization onto separate lines for maintainability (formatting-only, no logic change).
